measure.measure_definition: Measured value: absolute change in VAS score from baseline to week 12; Participants; 100 mm VAS (0 = no pain, 100 = worst pain possible); VAS scores recorded via weekly telephone follow-ups over 12 weeks, with the primary endpoint at week 12. Baseline and week-12 values used for change.; Mean reduction from baseline to week 12 in VAS score, reported as a positive magnitude of reduction. Higher VAS indicates worse pain. No responder threshold is applied to this measure.
measure.measure_name: Low back pain visual analogue scale (VAS) score

population.intervention: Minodronate; all participants also received calcium carbonate and vitamin D3 supplementation
population.intervention_regimen: Minodronate 1 mg/day; calcium carbonate providing calcium 600 mg and vitamin D3 125 IU (supplement); Minodronate orally once daily in the morning for 12 weeks; study drug then discontinued for 12 weeks. Calcium carbonate providing calcium 600 mg plus vitamin D3 125 IU after dinner throughout the study.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation to minodronate; included in the intention-to-treat efficacy analysis; Postmenopausal women aged >50 years with osteoporosis and chronic low back pain for ≥3 months, VAS score >30 mm, and serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D >20 ng/mL; no secondary osteoporosis, prior medications influencing bone metabolism, or conditions confounding bone-metabolism assessment; randomized to minodronate and included in the ITT analysis (flow chart: 37 included in ITT/SS).
population.population_time_frame: Trial initiated January 1, 2023; recruitment concluded April 11, 2024; 24-week trial (12-week treatment plus 12-week post-treatment observation).
